stories.summary: The Middle East crisis has caused a record 75% of the global long-range-2 (LR2) tanker fleet to switch from transporting refined fuels to shipping crude oil. This shift reflects significant disruptions in global energy supply chains.
stories.why: Changes in tanker usage patterns can lead to increased shipping costs and supply bottlenecks for refined products like diesel and gasoline, impacting global energy prices.
stories.why_moved: Disruptions to the efficient transport of crude and refined products create supply uncertainty, which is immediately reflected in energy commodity futures.

stories.headline: Yokohama Inaugurates in Coahuila Its Largest Plant in the World
stories.summary: Japanese company Yokohama Rubber inaugurated its largest plant in the world in Coahuila, Mexico. The company plans a 10bn peso investment in two phases, generating over 1,500 direct jobs.

stories.headline: Eurostar cancela los trenes entre Londres, París y Bruselas debido a huelga

stories.headline: Global Stock Markets Fall on Threat of New Trump Tariffs

stories.why: Global equity indexes reflect the combined value of listed companies across major economies, so trade-policy shocks and sector rotations feed directly into broad market performance.

stories.summary: Copper prices extended losses to hit their lowest level in almost a year on Wednesday. Selling pressure returned as the rally in artificial intelligence-related assets faded.

stories.summary: Australia has passed legislation requiring internet companies to proactively remove harmful content and functions. Penalties can reach 5% of global revenue.
